# Membrane PortAudio plugin v0.19.6 - Table of Contents

> Raw audio retriever and player based on PortAudio

## Pages

- [Membrane PortAudio plugin](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.PortAudio](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PortAudio.md): PortAudio utilities.

- [Membrane.PortAudio.Device](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PortAudio.Device.md): Struct carrying information about an audio device.
- [Membrane.PortAudio.Sink](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PortAudio.Sink.md): Audio sink that plays sound via multi-platform PortAudio library.
- [Membrane.PortAudio.Source](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PortAudio.Source.md): Audio source that captures sound via multi-platform PortAudio library.
- [Membrane.PortAudio.SyncExecutor](https://membrane-portaudio-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.PortAudio.SyncExecutor.md): A GenServer executing actions received by `GenServer.call/3` or `send/2`.
